findings.summary: Clove (Halal) is confirmed at 45981 Woodpecker Sq, Sterling, VA 20165. The old/different 45965 Regal Plaza Uber listing was excluded as a location mismatch.

The official menu publishes two 11-category Wix collections at once. They are near-duplicates but not identical, so all 22 category surfaces are preserved rather than collapsing away Chicken Qeema Paratha, Chicken Qeema Naan, or Rabri Falooda.
The current in-scope catalog consolidates 57 complete official, catering, Toast, and DoorDash surfaces into 128 unique food and nonalcoholic products after equivalent presentation collapse.

Seven frozen rows are menu-category headings rather than products, and Clove Special Chicken Bites is absent from all current exact-location surfaces. Those rows are reconciled as artifacts or stale instead of being republished.

No comprehensive official allergen matrix or facility cross-contact statement was found after all four required search classes. Direct contains positives are limited to literal restaurant-issued or exact linked-vendor names and ingredient descriptions; all other allergen status remains unavailable.
The current generated application snapshot contains no Clove/clovedmv restaurant record. The 95 frozen item-check rows therefore form the only packet projection available for reconciliation.
